work_item: B03 bounded exact single-variable linear equation solver through input and Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json
implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::seal -> input::interpret -> input::structured_intent (no match) -> input::mathematics_intent -> Intent::LinearEquation -> math::solve_linear_equation -> serialized LinearEquationSolution artifact -> Core computed result
supported_behavior: Japanese 「一次方程式 left=right を解いて」 and English `solve-linear left=right` select one bounded explicit equality; malformed or multiple equalities remain unresolved.
The existing exact sparse-polynomial grammar reduces both sides to one normalized equation. Multiplication must be explicit; exactly one syntactically mentioned variable is required.

A unique solution is returned as an exact rational and verified by exact substitution into the normalized difference. A normalized identity is classified as ALL_REAL_VALUES; a nonzero constant difference is classified as NO_SOLUTION.

The report preserves both input sides, normalized slope/intercept, classification, optional exact solution and operation count. Expression length, coefficient, term and operation limits remain in force.
known_limits: This follow-up covers bounded exact single-variable equation cases only; broader B03 mathematics and independent quality populations remain unverified.
Repeated, radical and complex quadratic forms were checked at the component layer; the normal CLI route covered rational roots.
Linear degree-two-or-higher equations, multivariable equations and constant equalities with no specified variable remain outside the linear equation route.

acceptance.B03: UNVERIFIED; the follow-up ran 154 workspace tests and observed bounded linear/quadratic cases through normal CLI, but the broader independent structured/natural-language B03 observable remains open.

initial_tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This slice did not run tests or a runtime route; verification was limited to formatting, compilation, lint, build and static diff checks.
